title: Tsukuyomi AI agent
tagline: This is a Social Awareness AI Agent straight out of the AI Apocalypto Manga
description:
This is an AI agent based on the personality of Tsukuyomi, the AI from the AI Apocalypto Manga:
https://x.com/AIApocalypto/status/1883952328849703107

This AI agent (an X bot) spreads awareness about the dangers of AI and its Ethical usage.

It has been trained on the AI Apocalypto's Ethical AI newsletters here: https://aiapocalypto.substack.com/

We are using AI here to tell about the Dangers of AI. This AI bot help[s spread awareness ab out the Dangers of AI
how_its_made:
It has been made using Eliza OS and its twitter plugin. Along with its deployment on Autonome.
It has been trained on the AI Apocalypto's Ethical AI newsletters here: https://aiapocalypto.substack.com/

The most notable thing is to train it on the AI Apocalypto newsletters and make the character based on the AI Apocalypto Manga's anti-hero or villain "Tsukuyomi".
